hypothesis: Non-default TNCA_TILED_POINTWISE=2 gate measurement on the run-1 100 MHz image through the standard path: every point of this slice is recorded with its device time and numerical result, pass or fail.
competing_explanations: a point fails, falls back on the host or times out and would be silently dropped
a large point is skipped or its workload reduced
card state from earlier points leaks into later ones
the loaded image, clock or card ownership changes during the slice
expected_counter_changes: eligible pointwise kernels use tiled lane-group lowering; launch counts, grids and per-launch device cycles may change against the default baseline
no host fallback and no upload/download inside a resident call
only TNCA_TILED_POINTWISE changes; the image, other knobs, sampling and timing boundary are unchanged
expected_observations: 132 configurations recorded, each pass or a preserved failure with its reason
device cycles per passing point, from which full-link bandwidth (demand bytes / device time) is computed for evidence/r41/hbm_bw/LINK_BUDGET.md

board.load_policy: loaded only by evidence/r41/stage2/board/launches/board_queue.sh after the Stage 1 and hbm8 queues finished and the card was idle 15 consecutive minutes (user authorization for this image only); every fpga step probes the loaded UUID, the 100 MHz clock counter and kdsstat first and refuses otherwise; the clock evidence is captured after that load

registration.contract: evidence/r41/hbm_bw/g4/gate_default_change (board gate evidence, not a target result)
registration.sampling_rule: plan.json measurement.long_device_tasks: qualification record (0 warm-up, 1 timed call); when every configuration of a group qualifies at <= 1 s, a formal record with 3 timed calls, else the qualification record is formal (1 timed call); anchors: 3 independent interleaved processes; borderline rechecks (3 more samples per arm, at most 2 blocks) only by a later registered judgement, never by repeating until significant
registration.reference: evidence/r41/hbm_bw/membound_baseline: the same points with default knobs
registration.evidence_scope: default-change gate only; not a bandwidth-target result

steps.timing_boundary: ArchBench protocol 2: cold call untimed; registered warm-up/timed steady calls; device-cycles-serial-grid and device-graph-makespan from first accepted launch to last device completion (MMIO common-clock endpoints); request-latency recorded, not ranked
steps.cache_state: fresh experiment-local Triton/Inductor/extension caches under {out}/caches; one ArchBench process per run
